# Build the future of human-first communication

Join a team driven by innovation, authenticity, and real impact.

[![UI Icon Mail RG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e351a8d671e3c6fc5f71_ui-icon-mail-rg.svg)\\

join our team](https://www.salesmail.com/careers#open-roles) [contact us](mailto:mailto:c)

## About our mission

We help organizations build stronger relationships through authentic, personalized video.

We believe technology should make people feel more connected — not less.

![UI Icon Pie Chart LG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e342acb4660ad1f85972_ui-icon-pie-chart-lg.avif)

## About our team

We’re creative thinkers, builders, and problem solvers focused on delivering world-class service and helping partners create memorable experiences.

If you value innovation, authenticity, and meaningful impact, you’ll fit right in.

![UI Icon Users LG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e343583b3e0bb7596da9_ui-icon-users-lg.avif)

## Our core values

![UI Icon Eye LG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e34262088927bd2ce766_ui-icon-eye-lg.avif)

### Authenticity

We believe human connection wins. We approach every interaction, internally and externally, with transparency and sincerity.

![UI Icon Flame LG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e3429dd1fe5b53c0cf5a_ui-icon-flame-lg.avif)

### Impact

We are results-obsessed. Every team member focuses on delivering measurable value to our partners and making a real difference.

![UI Icon Globe LG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e342f71fc6c2deb2cde6_ui-icon-globe-lg.avif)

### World-class service

We are committed to empowering our partners and providing a support experience that is second to none.

![UI Icon Lightbulb LG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e3427edbe9b69bafb424_ui-icon-lightbulb-lg.avif)

### Innovation

We are a team of creative thinkers and problem solvers, constantly pushing the boundaries of human-first technology.

![UI Icon Check LG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e342a5f4e9d1c3ad729a_ui-icon-check-lg.avif)

### Simplicity

We design elegant solutions that make complex communication effortless. Great technology should make life easier.

![UI Icon Plant LG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e3426301cbf31ac05217_ui-icon-plant-lg.avif)

### Growth mindset

We embrace challenges as opportunities to learn and evolve. We encourage continuous personal and professional development.

## Open roles

We are obsessed with delivering world-class service to our business partners, empowering them to build strong relationships and create memorable experiences with the audiences that matter most to them.
